integrity: Analytic derivations establish the infinite and asymptotic claims. The finite checker is supplementary and does not constitute independent validation.
scientific_limitations: The model is a one-dimensional, uniform, independent-panel, two-evaluation antithetic quadrature. No bounds for arbitrary irregular functions or inter-panel couplings are claimed; historical specialist overlap remains possible.
title: Sharp singularity thresholds and constants for antithetic stratified quadrature
